notes.frame:attack: a: clean flat green window, crisp brass linework, matches the L-cards attack frame. b rejected: brown smudge painted into the window.
notes.frame:skill: a: crisper sapphire gems; a and b are near identical, both windows within 0.5 px of the attack window.
notes.frame:sigil: a: true emerald field and gems; a and b are near identical.
notes.cog-toss: a: clear cog silhouette, die shows pips only. b: cog and spark ring merge into a blur.
notes.ratchet-flurry: b: full-square painting, clear arm, blade and crossing slash arcs. a: pre-cropped to a circle on black.
notes.rivet-volley: a: muzzle centred with the rivet fan around it. b: porthole framing pushes the subject off-centre.
notes.escapement-hammer: b: full-square, the escapement-anchor head and impact read clearly. a: pre-cropped circle with white corners and a muddier impact.
notes.defend: b: full-square painting, larger shield read. a: pre-cropped to a circle with white corners.
notes.lucky-rivets: a: open palm with floating rivets, pip die and the rivet-plate ring all readable. b: hand fills the frame, plate ring lost.
notes.release-valve: a: handwheel centred with the steam jet. b: pre-cropped circle with white corners.
notes.overwind: b: stronger sapphire energy spiral and a clearer key silhouette.
notes.spanner-jam: a: full-square, spanner and gears read clearly. b: pre-cropped circle with white corners.
notes.cogstorm: a: clean single-line gear sigil with the cog whirlwind. b: adds a spiral inside the gear, which reads as the Time Spiral sigil.
notes.furnace-brand: a: larger flame sigil above the pip die, furnace mouth readable. b: the same composition, smaller subject.
notes.warding-glyph: a: circle-and-triangle sigil centred inside the hexagonal barrier. b: sigil pushed low, barrier cropped.
notes.arc-bolt: a: large, clean single-line bolt sigil between the coils. b: full-square but the bolt is small and two-tone.
notes.time-spiral: a: large clear spiral sigil with clock hands. b: the hands cross the spiral and hide it.
